keyTakeaways.text: Wireless Communication: The company’s 5G renewal cycle has come to an end and will restart in FY 2030, with FY 2027 marking the start of its non-handset revenue inflection.
FRAND & Licensing: Agreements with Apple, Huawei and Transsion maintain royalty rates, its finance chief says, and provide stability ahead of the next renewal cycle in fiscal 2030 to 2033
